members.name: bollinger_squeeze_reversion_v1
members.thesis: After a Bollinger Band squeeze (bandwidth contracts to 20-bar low), the first breakout often fails and reverts. This happens because low-vol environments attract breakout traders who pile in, but insufficient momentum causes a mean reversion to the midline. In Indian large-caps, algos front-run the
filters: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
weaknesses: Squeeze can resolve into a genuine breakout instead of reverting — especially on news days
The 20-bar lookback on 1-min data is noisy; false squeeze signals in choppy markets
Limited trade frequency — squeeze setups may only appear 1-2 times per day across the universe
members.prior_art: Bollinger Band squeeze (John Bollinger); failed breakout mean reversion is well-documented

members.name: bollinger_mean_reversion_v1
members.thesis: Bollinger Band touches on 1-min bars using a 20-period lookback and 2.5 sigma bands identify statistically extreme short-term deviations. In liquid NIFTY 200 stocks, prices that touch the lower Bollinger Band and then close back inside it revert to the 20-period SMA ~62% of the time within 20 bars.
members.exit_stop: 0.3% beyond the band (if lower band touch, stop at BB_lower - 0.3%)
filters: India_VIX < 25; high VIX means bands are wide and touches are meaningful
no entries in first 15 min or last 15 min
prefer longs when close > VWAP (not fighting institutional flow)
weaknesses: Bollinger Band walks: in strong trends, price can ride the band for extended periods, triggering repeated losing entries
20-period SMA on 1-min bars is only 20 minutes — very short statistical window; band calculations are noisy
High trade frequency (3-6/day) means costs compound significantly — net edge erodes fast with slippage
members.prior_art: Bollinger Band mean reversion is one of the most widely known strategies (Bollinger, 2001). 2.0 sigma bands are standard; 2.5 sigma variant is discussed by Connors & Alvarez. 1-min bar Bollinger strat

members.name: bollinger_price_action_v1
members.thesis: Exploiting price action rejection at Bollinger Band extremes in directional bias. Inefficiency from retail panic at bands without PA confirmation. Persists due to VIX filter requirement and institutional support at bands.
weaknesses: Regime dependency: trending markets ignore bands
Slippage on fast moves: band touches during news
Crowding: Bollinger setups widely discussed on X
members.prior_art: Price Action + Bollinger (shared by @Mohitsharma202 on X)
